**Hero image prompt** (paste into Midjourney / Flux / etc.):

```
Overhead food photo of a deep ceramic bowl of Instant Pot beefy taco pasta on a worn wooden kitchen table, soft natural window light from the left. Short twisted pasta (campanelle or fusilli) coated in a rich red-orange tomato-taco sauce, browned ground beef in small chunks, thick-sliced cooked mushrooms, and a generous shower of grated Parmesan. Steam rising slightly. Rustic weeknight dinner look — not restaurant plating. Shallow depth of field, appetizing texture on the sauce and cheese, warm amber tones, slight pepper flecks visible. Photorealistic, high detail, no text, no logos, no Instant Pot in frame, no hands.
```

**Alt / negative (optional):**
```
cartoon, illustration, plastic food, burnt edges, raw meat, spaghetti strands, empty bowl, cluttered props, watermark, text overlay, neon colors, purple lighting
```

**Filename once you generate:** `instant-pot-beefy-taco-pasta.jpg` under `static/images/`, then set frontmatter `image: "/images/instant-pot-beefy-taco-pasta.jpg"`.
